sentence_stem: Although the study was based on a small sample,
correct_completion: its findings were widely cited by other researchers.
full_sentence: Although the study was based on a small sample, its findings were widely cited by other researchers.
acceptable_variants: its conclusions still attracted wide attention.
other researchers nevertheless referred to its results.

options.text: so its findings were limited to one city.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not a contrast. After 'although' the sentence needs a clause that goes against the expectation created by the small sample.

options.text: the researchers collected data over two years.
options.why_wrong: This adds neutral background information but does not contrast with the small sample mentioned in the stem.

options.text: the sample was chosen at random.
options.why_wrong: This describes how the sample was selected; it does not provide the contrasting outcome that 'although' requires.

options.text: its findings were widely cited by other researchers.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. A small sample normally suggests weak results, so the correct clause reverses that expectation.
translation: Mimo że badanie opierało się na małej próbie, jego wyniki były szeroko cytowane przez innych badaczy.
